note: node_keep_token adds a keeper_machine_name string base field to nodes and registers node-keep tokens ([node-keep:<machine_name>:alias|id|url|uri]) for every protected (node_keeper=1) node that has a machine name, plus the service node_keep_token.helper (NodeKeepTokenService). Depends on node_keep + token, both enabled here. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real node field values (keeper_machine_name) and the live token replacement, using namespaced Article nodes titled 'NKT ...'.

evals.prompt: The node_keep_token module exposes protected nodes as tokens. If a protected node has the Node Keep machine name 'home', which tokens can I use to output that node's URL path and its node id?
evals.expected_output: Use tokens of the node-keep type: [node-keep:home:url] for the URL path and [node-keep:home:id] for the node id (also :alias and :uri are available).

evals.prompt: Which base field does node_keep_token add to nodes to make a protected node token-addressable, and what are the rules for its value?
evals.expected_output: The keeper_machine_name string base field. It only appears when the node is protected (node_keeper checked), must be unique across protected nodes, and may only contain lowercase letters, numbers and underscores ([a-z0-9_]+).

evals.prompt: In node_keep_token, which service and method would you call to load a protected node by its Node Keep machine name in custom code?
evals.expected_output: Call the node_keep_token.helper service (NodeKeepTokenService) and its getProtectedNodeByMachineName($machine_name) method, e.g. \Drupal::service('node_keep_token.helper')->getProtectedNodeByMachineName('home').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site a protected Article node titled 'NKT Probe' has been given a Node Keep machine name for tokens. Inspect the live site and state that machine name.
evals.expected_output: Its keeper_machine_name is 'nkt_probe' (readable via the keeper_machine_name field on the node, or node_keep_token.helper::getProtectedMachineNames()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a protected node whose Node Keep token machine name is 'nkt_home'. Inspect the live site and give the title of that node.
evals.expected_output: The node with keeper_machine_name 'nkt_home' is titled 'NKT Home Page' (use node_keep_token.helper::getProtectedNodeByMachineName('nkt_home') or query keeper_machine_name).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a protected Article node titled 'NKT Task'. Using node_keep_token, give it the Node Keep machine name 'nkt_task' so it can be referenced by node-keep tokens. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set keeper_machine_name to 'nkt_task' on the protected 'NKT Task' node and save it (the node already has node_keeper=1).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a protected Article node titled 'NKT Render'. Configure node_keep_token so that the token [node-keep:nkt_render:id] resolves to that node's id. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Give the protected 'NKT Render' node the keeper_machine_name 'nkt_render' and save; then [node-keep:nkt_render:id] replaces to that node's nid.
